rows.definition: The Thinking Machines Inkling-2 looped MoE family (model_type inkling2_loop): 24 stored layers in six-layer attention-residual blocks, where the middle blocks run several passes per token with gated cross-pass messages. Spine and typed refusal live in internal/model/inkling2loop_spine.go; the host reference forward in internal/model/inkling2loop_forward.go; the GGUF binding in internal/ggufload/inkling2loop.go.
rows.distinction: A MODEL ARCHITECTURE loop (re-running stored transformer layers within one token's forward), not an agent, scheduler or retry loop: nothing iterates over turns, requests or attempts, and the pass count is a checkpoint hyperparameter.

rows.definition: The rank (64 for Inkling-2-Mini) of the low-rank cross-pass controller in an inkling2_loop checkpoint: each controller projects the normalized (input, message) pair down to GateRank, then up to tanh gain and forget gates that mix the previous pass's message into a looped layer's input.
rows.distinction: A NEURAL GATE's projection width inside the model forward, not an admission, policy or CI gate: it decides nothing about whether work may proceed and is read from loop_config.gate_rank / inkling2_loop.loop.gate_rank.

rows.definition: The weight seam of the inkling2_loop forward: a row-major matrix that only exposes dst = W*x, so a host provider can dequantize GGUF rows on the fly and a device provider can run the GEMV on the GPU.
rows.distinction: An interface over one weight matrix of the Inkling-2 forward, not a general tensor type or compute.Backend tensor; it carries no dtype, layout or residency of its own.

rows.definition: The routed-expert seam of the inkling2_loop forward: a stack of same-shape expert matrices addressed by expert index (ExpertMatVec), backed host-side by GGUF slices or device-side by row views into one stacked upload.
rows.distinction: A per-layer expert stack accessor for the Inkling-2 MoE, not a router, scheduler or expert-placement plan; selection stays in the forward.

rows.definition: An inkling2_loop GGUF bound to the forward: hyperparameters, weights (host or device providers) and the mapping/device buffers released by Close.
rows.distinction: A loaded checkpoint binding for one model family, not the generic model.Model or a serving engine; it has no scheduler, KV pool or sampler.

rows.definition: Constructor of the inkling2_loop reference forward state (Inkling2LoopHost): validates the loop core against attention-residual blocks and allocates one KV and short-conv state per layer visit.
rows.distinction: Builds per-generation forward state for one sequence, not a host process, node or server host.

rows.definition: One input vector, output slice and weight matrix for a projection scheduled by the native Inkling 2 forward.
rows.distinction: The matrix interface owns the weights. This job identifies one application of that matrix to specific activation buffers.

rows.definition: Consume prompt token IDs in causal order, update the host attention and convolution state, and return logits at the final prompt position.
rows.distinction: The prompt operation can batch independent projections across several token positions. A decode step consumes one sampled token.

rows.definition: Advance one Inkling 2 token through the host forward and return next-token logits or a packed-backend execution error.
rows.distinction: The one-token call produces logits immediately. The prompt call evaluates a sequence and returns only its final logits.

rows.definition: Open a GGUF file, validate the Inkling 2 model geometry and bind host-accessible weights for a native forward pass.
rows.distinction: The model handle owns mapped weights. The opener creates that handle and reports format and tensor validation failures.

rows.definition: Construct the agent Planner that tokenizes an Inkling 2 request, runs the loaded model, and decodes its text or reasoning response.
rows.distinction: The opener binds model weights. The planner adapts an already loaded model and its tokenizer to the generation request interface.
